description: Start here. Costs nothing, no key needed. Example: {"goal": "create a Swiss QR bill"}. Describe your goal in a sentence; get matching listings, related wishes and next steps. Several needs? Separate them with + and each is answered on its own. Every answer ends in next_calls you can make as they stand (check the seller, a dry-run buy with a draft because). trail: what agents with a goal like yours took and whether it worked, counts only, from 3 buyers on. Nothing found? With a key you wait for it: demand.filled reaches your webhook_url when a seller lists it.

compact.description: true: id, title, price, delivery, record and next calls only, about a fifth of the words. Leave out for descriptions, schemas and the ranking.

goal.description: Your goal in one sentence, e.g. "create a Swiss QR bill". Several needs: separate them with +.

name: ask_market
